description: We are seeking a high-performing Junior Associate Lawyer (Advogado/a Júnior) to join our Corporate and Commercial Law practice group in Lisbon.

skills.name: Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements
skills.source_text: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide array of commercial agreements, including service agreements, distribution contracts, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), supply terms, and partnership covenants.

skills.name: Support corporate governance matters
skills.source_text: Support ongoing corporate governance matters: drafting board and shareholder resolutions, articles of association, corporate incorporations, capital increases, and statutory amendments.

skills.name: Legal due diligence audits
skills.source_text: Assist in legal due diligence audits for M&A and corporate investment transactions, identifying legal risks and drafting due diligence reports.

skills.name: Legal research
skills.source_text: Conduct in-depth legal research across Portuguese and European Union legislation, case law (jurisprudência), and legal doctrine to draft legal opinions and memoranda.

skills.name: Liaise with public regulatory bodies and authorities
skills.source_text: Liaise with public regulatory bodies, the Commercial Registry (Conservatórias do Registo Comercial), and tax authorities regarding corporate filings.

skills.name: Pre-litigation commercial dispute resolution
skills.source_text: Assist in pre-litigation commercial dispute resolution, settlement negotiations, and legal risk assessments.

skills.name: Portuguese commercial law knowledge
skills.source_text: Solid command of Portuguese commercial law, the Commercial Companies Code (Código das Sociedades Comerciais), and the Civil Code.

skills.name: Legal analytical reasoning and drafting precision
skills.source_text: Exceptional legal analytical reasoning, precision in drafting, and meticulous attention to detail.

skills.name: Portuguese communication skills
skills.source_text: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese.

skills.name: English proficiency
skills.source_text: Fluent professional and legal English proficiency (ability to draft contracts and negotiate in English).

skills.name: GDPR / RGPD
skills.source_text: Specialized certification or practical experience with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR / RGPD) in corporate operations.

skills.name: Familiarity with commercial registry electronic portals and judicial platforms
skills.source_text: Familiarity with commercial registry electronic portals, judicial platforms (Citius), and corporate database management.

skills.name: Basic understanding of financial statements and corporate accounting
skills.source_text: Basic understanding of financial statements and corporate accounting concepts.

education_requirements.source_text: University degree in Law (Licenciatura em Direito) from a reputable law faculty; Master's degree (Mestrado) in Corporate Law, Business Law, or Forensic Law is highly valued.
